scope: Actual MIDP2-RU JimmUI.gotoURL and the URL-list commandAction route, real Util URL parsing, TextList wrapping, tagged selection, text/font metrics, command labels and screen transitions. All eight font bit masks, three contact-font option values and four terminal results are exercised. The URL list retains its native fixed small font; 176x220 MicroEmulator pixels are compared. Only JimmUI platformRequest calls are captured; an Exception is swallowed and an Error escapes as in the original. Existing login/date fixtures provide inert surrounding initialization. Whole controller bytecode is verified unchanged before capture; only terminal call instructions change afterward. No physical browser launch, device rendering or complete controller equivalence claim.
